# Models saved by real releases

These files were written by the releases named below, not generated by a
format library, and their version headers are unedited. They are MIT-licensed
by their authors; each grant is in the `LICENSE-*` file beside them.
`tools/fetch-skp-fixtures.sh` reproduces the downloads and checks SHA-256.

| Files | Header | Source | Regression |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HexCrater.skp` | `{18.0.16113}` | quad-tools extension `thomthom/quadface-tools@481e6951`, `Test Models/` | Real 2018 model: 4,690 faces through the exchange chain. |
| `LiveComponent.skp` | `{21.0.0}` | test suite | Classic archive with a 2021 header: filler before the definition count. |
| `skp-vff-hard-block.skp` | `{21.0.0}` | test suite | 2021 container, 64 faces. |
| `uv_tile_at.skp` | `{21.1.0}` | test suite | 2021.1 container with a tiled texture. |
| `skp-vff-soft-block.skp` | `{22.0.0}` | test suite | 2022 container, 69 faces. |
| `missing_material.skp` | `{21.0.339}` | test suite | An image entity whose material has no texture still saves. |
| `ReversedFaces-SmallModel.skp` | `{15.2.685}` | solid-tools extension `thomthom/solid-inspector@e238257f`, `Tests/` | A sliver whose apex lies on its opposite side. |
| `PrusaI3_Extruder2.skp` | `{15.3.331}` | as above | Warped faces and slivers; 16 facets keep only their wires. |
| `degenerate-uv-box.skp` | `{15.2.685}` | as above (`box.skp`) | A face whose texture samples fit no single placement. |

"Test suite" is the vendor's own MIT-licensed extension test repository, GitHub
repository id 15951247 at commit `8d9c2acdb0d4a46f5e2cddc60a2fc4a0f67a09bd`. The
fetch script addresses its files by git blob id, which also pins their content.
`LICENSE-test-suite` retains that repository's grant unchanged.

These are genuine files, but a release's coverage is only as wide as its files:
they do not certify every entity type in that release. 2023 and 2024 still have
no release fixture; no public, redistributable file was found. Their container
family lies between the certified 2022 and 2026 files.
